profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA. Its AI-facing site presents it as a platform for developers to build with Meta's AI models and tools, centered on the Meta Model API, which is described as compatible with the OpenAI SDK and designed to get developers to a first working request in under five minutes. The API includes a search grounding feature that gives models live access to the web via a single tool call.

The company's tracked AI product is Llama, an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted. The site also describes several models and tools under the Muse name: Muse Spark, described as a coding-optimized model competitive with leading alternatives and designed for coding agents, reviewing bots, and AI-assisted development; Muse Code, a coding agent built to run Muse Spark; and Muse Glimmer, a 30-billion-parameter open model optimized for local agent workflows and small enough to run on a Mac or PC with a single consumer GPU. The site additionally references multi-agent workflow support on a single model capable of interacting with a computer by clicking through apps and moving between interfaces.

Meta is a public company trading under the ticker META with a CIK of 0001326801. Its most recently recorded annual revenue was $200,966,000,000 for the period ending 2025-12-31, reported on a 10-K filing. The company is a defendant in two cases in the Northern District of California, Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. Several third-party MCP servers have been built around Meta's advertising infrastructure, covering campaign management, creative testing, and audience tools across Facebook and Instagram.
